functional.summary: Live check against this worktree's own servers (backend cwd verified, llmProvider bedrock at startup) with a real Bedrock model configured - so the Success path was exercised for real rather than recorded as blocked. The standalone /ask page renders the prototype's chrome: the 'Ask about this report. Answers are verified against the source.' line, a Suggested row whose seeds are catalog-drawn ('Show MIS statement Actual for Agriculture Nursery DUB this month'), the composer with its Send control, and Ask as a live shell destination. Driving the real API end to end, every branch of the response matrix renders correctly and exactly one at a time: a data question returns success with provenance.verified true and a real result row; 'What does Actual mean?' returns the informational definition; 'Why is labour high?' - which is NOT discrepancy-shaped - is declined with 'I can't infer why a result is high or low', proving task 1's new causal classifier; 'What is the capital of France?' returns not_supported naming the two registered domains; and 'hello there' returns the deterministic greeting template carrying the brand token and no data claim. viewInReport is present on EVERY response, with the unavailable arm carrying its reason rather than being silently absent.
manual_validation_steps: Confirmed the backend process cwd is this worktree and its startup log reports llmProvider bedrock before trusting anything.
Loaded /ask and confirmed the prototype chrome, the catalog-drawn seed chips, the composer and Ask as a live nav destination.
Asked a data question through the API as the authenticated user: responseClass success, provenance.verified true, one result row.

Asked a definition, a causal why, an off-topic question and a greeting: informational, informational (causal decline), not_supported, informational (greeting template) - four distinct branches, each alone.
Confirmed viewInReport is present on every response and that its unavailable arm carries a reason ('This response cannot be opened in the MIS statement...').
Verified the registered dimension catalog (gl_code, month, leaf_key) to judge whether suggested chips are answerable.
non_blocking_findings: Server-supplied suggestedQuestions are the vendored Pulse examples - 'Actual by state', 'Actual last 30 days' - and reference a state dimension the semantic layer does not register, so clicking one returns not_supported. The seeds this task owns ARE catalog-drawn; the defect is in backend HelpService, outside a frontend-only task, and is ledgered as D-0040.

Two false alarms during the check were mine, not the product's, and are recorded so a later reader does not chase them: a question typed into an already-populated composer produced a mangled string that fell to the definition branch, and a burst of rapid API probes reused a rotated CSRF token and drew a 403 from CsrfGuard rather than from the assistant.
residual_risks: The configured model is mistral.mistral-large-3-675b-instruct. Decision 0027 fixes the provider and region, not the family, so this is compliant - but answer quality and selection behaviour ride on it and were not otherwise assessed.
The docked panel on the MIS report was exercised through the same shared component as /ask; a separate visual pass on the report page is covered by the design review rather than this check.

automated.summary: All five verify commands pass and all ten required leaves execute under their exact testcase names, read from the junit reports rather than exit codes (vitest exits 0 having asserted nothing when -t matches no leaf, D-0031). The leaves cover a rendered success with its verified badge, provenance disclosure and no number the response did not carry; the chart fallback when a shape cannot be drawn honestly; both arms of the viewInReport union; the statement side's refresh-required branch proven in mis-report-view.test.tsx rather than in an ask-panel test; the informational payload rendering its definition and suggestions rather than an empty message; each message-bearing failure class alone; a selectable clarification that does not read as an error; prior turns carrying only successful turns and surviving the docked-to-page navigation but not a reload; the two surfaces rendering from one component with Ask as a live shell destination; and the api client's route, CSRF header and exact request body driven directly rather than through a mock.
automated.pass_fail_summary: frontend 53 tests passed, backend 131 passed, 0 failures; required leaves 10/10 under their exact testcase name; typecheck, lint, format:check and the production build clean
remaining_gaps: Server-supplied suggestedQuestions come from the vendored HelpService and name a 'state' dimension the semantic layer does not register, so a suggested chip returns not_supported. The seeds this task owns are catalog-drawn; the server half is backend and is ledgered as D-0040.

recharts was installed and then exact-pinned by the orchestrator under ledgered degraded windows Q-0032-fcc8 and Q-0033-c7cf, because the sandbox has neither npm registry access nor a readable host cache. No feature code was written outside the implementer.
